METADATA.TITLE: {appName}: value bets and arbs priced against the sharp line
METADATA.DESCRIPTION: Value bets and arbs from soft bookmakers, priced against the sharp fair line, with a public record.

FOOTER.HONEST: 18+ only. OpenEV shows prices and probabilities, not certainties, and no edge is guaranteed. If betting stops being fun, free help is at <aware>GambleAware</aware>. Prices are read from the public sites of bookmakers and exchanges, the fair line comes from Pinnacle with the margin removed, final scores from ESPN. Check every price at the bookmaker before you bet.

FAQ.TITLE: Honest answers.
FAQ.LINE: What we would ask before trusting a tool like this.
FAQ.A_PROFIT: No. Value bets lose often, the edge only shows over hundreds of bets, and losing runs are part of it.
FAQ.A_LIMIT: Probably, at soft books. Round stakes, normal bets in between and several books delay it; the tracker shows which account runs hot.
FAQ.Q_DATA: Where does the data come from?
FAQ.A_DATA: Public prices from {count} bookmakers and exchanges, read every few seconds. Pinnacle is the sharp line, final scores come from ESPN.
FAQ.A_FAIR: Pinnacle's margin is removed with the power method. Where Betfair or Matchbook has a tight market, it has to agree before an alert goes out.
FAQ.A_LOSSES: A record without losses is an advert. Every alert stays in it, checked against the closing line.
FAQ.A_FREE: Yes, during the preview. No card and no email to look; Discord sign in only to track bets and get alerts. If a paid plan comes, its price is on this page first.
FAQ.A_AI: No. It is arithmetic: Pinnacle's price with the margin removed, compared with every book. Each row shows the numbers it used.

FINAL.LINE: The board is open. No card, no sign up.
FINAL.HEADING: See today's value bets.

VALUE_BETS.LABEL: Positive EV
VALUE_BETS.HEADING: Value bets
VALUE_BETS.SUBHEADING: A bet shows up when a bookmaker pays more than the fair odds, which come from Pinnacle with its margin removed. Click a bet to see every book on that market, how the fair price was built and how the price moved.
VALUE_BETS.EMPTY: No value right now with these filters. Prices update every few seconds.
VALUE_BETS.NOTE_FAIR: Fair odds use the power devig of Pinnacle. The safe EV uses the least favourable of four methods, so it is the cautious number.
VALUE_BETS.NOTE_CONFIDENCE: Confidence follows Pinnacle's maximum stake on the market: the more money it accepts, the more the fair price can be trusted.
VALUE_BETS.NOTE_STAKE: Stake is quarter Kelly on a bankroll of 1000. Sign in to use your own bankroll and Kelly fraction. A price not reconfirmed within five minutes drops off the board.
VALUE_BETS.NOTE_STAKE_USER: Stake is {fraction} Kelly on your bankroll of {bankroll}, from your settings, after exchange commission. A price not reconfirmed within five minutes drops off the board.
VALUE_BETS.LEAD: Bets where a bookmaker pays more than Pinnacle's fair price. Every row shows its reference and how old the price is.
VALUE_BETS.MY_BOOKS_TITLE: Which books can you bet at?
VALUE_BETS.MY_BOOKS_LINE_IN: Pick them once and the board shows only bets you can place. Saved to your account.
VALUE_BETS.MY_BOOKS_LINE_OUT: Pick them once and the board shows only bets you can place. Saved in this browser, no sign in needed.

BET.LABEL: Value bet
BET.GONE_TITLE: This price is no longer value
BET.GONE_BODY: The bookmaker moved, the fair line moved, or the game started. Value bets live only while the price beats the fair odds.
BET.TITLE: {bet} at {book}
BET.SUMMARY: {market} in {home} v {away}. {book} pays {odds} where the fair price is {fair}, a {chance} chance.
BET.DEVIG_TITLE: How the fair price is built
BET.METHOD_POWER_NOTE: Used for the headline EV. Takes more margin off long shots, as books do.
BET.METHOD_MULT_NOTE: Scales every outcome by the same factor.
BET.METHOD_ADD_NOTE: Removes the same amount from every outcome.
BET.METHOD_WORST_NOTE: The least favourable of the others for this bet. The safe EV.
BET.DEVIG_NOTE: Pinnacle prices this market with a {margin} margin and takes up to {stake} on it. Pinnacle was last seen {sharpSeen}, {book} {bookSeen}.
BET.ELSEWHERE_EMPTY: No other book prices this outcome.
BET.BEFORE_PRICE: Check the price at {book} is still {odds} or better.
BET.BEFORE_FAIR: Below {fair} the bet has no edge. Skip it.
BET.BEFORE_ROUND: Round the stake to a normal number. Odd amounts get accounts flagged.
BET.BEFORE_MIX: Mix in normal bets so the account does not look like it only takes value.
BET.FEE_COMMISSION: {book} keeps {commission} commission on net winnings, so every EV here uses the net odds of {net} instead of {odds}.
BET.FEE_TAKER: {book} charges a taker fee of {fee} times the price times one minus the price, so every EV here uses the net odds of {net} instead of {odds}.

ARBS.LABEL: Sure bets
ARBS.HEADING: Arbitrage
ARBS.SUBHEADING: Back every outcome at the book paying the most and the return is the same whatever happens. Stakes below split {total} so every outcome pays out the same. Arbs close fast: confirm every leg before placing the first one.
ARBS.EMPTY: No arbitrage right now. Soft books rarely disagree by enough at the same time; they show up most around team news and line moves.

PROOF.LABEL: Public record
PROOF.HEADING: Every alert, next to the closing line
PROOF.SUBHEADING: Each bet that crosses +2% EV is written down the moment it is found, with the price and the fair odds at that moment. Nothing is removed afterwards. At kickoff the last Pinnacle fair price becomes the closing line. Beating the close is the best evidence an edge was real, long before results settle it.
PROOF.CLV_HINT: Alert odds against the closing fair odds
PROOF.RESULTS_NOTE: Results take hundreds of bets to separate skill from luck. Closing line value shows it much sooner, so it stays the headline.
PROOF.SETTLED_HINT: Alerts with a final score, out of {closed} past kickoff
PROOF.RECORD_HINT: Plus {half_won} half won and {half_lost} half lost on quarter lines
PROOF.UNITS_HINT: Profit at a flat stake of 1 unit per alert, after commission
PROOF.ROI_HINT: Units won per unit staked on settled alerts

HEALTH.WHY_BODY: Value betting only pays while your accounts stay open. Bookmakers limit accounts that look like they only bet when the price is wrong. This page reads your tracked bets the way a trader would and tells you, book by book, what stands out.
HEALTH.TIP_MIX: Mix in ordinary bets, such as popular games and accumulators.
HEALTH.TIP_ROUND: Stake round amounts like 10, 25 or 50, never 23.47.
HEALTH.TIP_SPREAD: Spread your bets over several bookmakers instead of hammering one.
HEALTH.TIP_TIMING: Avoid betting the second a line opens or on obscure markets only.
HEALTH.TIP_WITHDRAW: Withdraw now and then and keep the account looking like a normal punter's.
HEALTH.EMPTY: Track a few bets first. The check needs at least 5 bets at a bookmaker.
HEALTH.VALUE_SHARE_HINT: Share of bets tracked from a value bet or placed above the fair price
HEALTH.ROUND_SHARE_HINT: Share of stakes that are a whole multiple of 5
HEALTH.LOW_LIQUIDITY_HINT: Share of bets on markets where Pinnacle took less than 1,000
HEALTH.TOO_FEW: Fewer than 5 bets here, too early to judge.
HEALTH.ALL_CLEAR: Nothing stands out at this bookmaker.

WARN.ALL_VALUE_BETS: Almost every bet here is a value bet.
WARN.ALL_VALUE_BETS_FIX: Bookmakers profile accounts that only take mispriced lines. Place some ordinary bets on popular games too.
WARN.NEVER_ROUND_FIX: Amounts like 23.47 look like a staking formula. Round to 5 or 10.
WARN.LOW_LIQUIDITY: Most bets are on thin markets.
WARN.LOW_LIQUIDITY_FIX: Books watch winners closest on low limit markets. Favour bigger leagues and main markets.
WARN.BEATS_CLOSE: You beat the closing line on most bets.
WARN.BEATS_CLOSE_FIX: That is the main signal books limit on. Good for your edge, so protect the account with the other habits above.
